Prepare the work package for: ${input}

Choose `Project Bootstrap` when structure, flows, or architecture are still undefined, otherwise
choose `Work Item Design`. Delegate requirements to `karl` and architecture to `ralph`, then
reconcile their output. Do not create any work item and do not write feature code before the human
approves the package. Report unresolved points under `Domande aperte`.
